syllabus.clause: regional failover of pipelines and catalogs

at.step: Reveal: RPO and RTO per data class

items.item: Personal data must be kept in a form permitting identification for no longer than necessary.
The controller must be responsible for, and able to demonstrate compliance with, the Article 5(1) principles.
The controller must implement appropriate technical and organisational measures, such as pseudonymisation, by design and by default.
A transfer of personal data to a third country is permitted only if the conditions in GDPR Chapter V are met.

sources.source: AWS, "Meeting compliance requirements with S3 Replication Time Control"

items.item: S3 RTC replicates most objects in seconds, and 99.9 percent within 15 minutes.
The Europe (Ireland) data-transfer-out-to-internet rate is $0.09 per GB, as of the date this topic was researched.
Replication and federation are each a computed cost and a computed risk, not a default choice made out of habit.
Replicating only a de-identified aggregate can satisfy both the privacy officer's question and the dashboard's performance need at once.
Bucket replication alone is not failover; the catalog, the keys and the pipeline state each need their own, separate plan.
A global figure is only as fresh as its single stalest region, and a cross-region strongly consistent counter costs a real round trip.
A faster replication tool does not fix a residency violation; the violation is about which rows are allowed to move at all.

at.step: Predict: which two decisions would have prevented both?

items.item: Excluding a still-backfilling region from a global figure, and saying so, is more honest than blending its partial numbers in unmarked.

at.step: Prove it: a third region, mid-backfill

items.item: This topic leaves out the cloud regions and residency regulations themselves, replication and DR mechanics, consistency theory, and tenant isolation.
Residency-constrained placement, replicate-versus-federate decisions, and cross-region consistency tradeoffs are each established practice, not an emerging technique.
This topic gives the shop its two-region design; the next design must isolate and charge businesses that are themselves the platform's tenants.
A weekend replication done for performance, with nobody checking which data it was allowed to move, is exactly how a residency violation happens unnoticed.

at.step: Hook: a weekend replication crosses a border
